    "3fa501a9: ;If task not already queued, close current device.",
    "ea8a0bbc: ;\n .;Kill all variables used by this routine, apart from those that may have\n .;been saved by the SAVE logic.",
    "d72f5157: ;End of END tag.",
    "3468ebe2: ;Execute the specified program (DGPGM/PGM), or CLOSE if neither defined.",
    "947574fb: ;\n .;Unwind scheduled task by deleting temp globals created by %ZTLOAD\n .;and close any device assignment.",
    "261a0bd0: ;End of DQ tag.",
    "587a47d3:  .;\n .;If ZTSK(\"D\") exists, convert the queued date/time value into\n .;internal FileMan formats %H (date) and Z (time).\n .;Uses %DTC utility to convert external date value.",
    "3e99cf5c: ;End of DTQ tag."
  ]
}
